composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. creative_direction: Design a blue-and-white porcelain flying fish with broad leaflike fins extending from a plump body and a slim gently curved tail. Show it as a suspended ceramic ornament, with no visible string, above a faint grounding shadow. Use simple cloud-shaped blue glaze patches, clean edges, and a small bright eye. Keep the background warm pearl gray and the lighting diffuse, preserving distinct negative spaces around both fins. Square 1024x1024, with a clear central silhouette and no circular border. Original peaceful design, no lettering, logos, or watermark.
